content_text_body:
Understanding what it takes to cultivate a feeling of acceptance among your team can help you foster a sense of inclusion. The goal is to nurture a work environment where everyone feels accepted and diversity is valued. 

To start, read this [article](https://hbr.org/2017/07/4-ways-managers-can-be-more-inclusive) describing four ways managers can become more inclusive. These recommendations can help you to prioritize inclusion in your everyday functions in an intentional and effective way. 

### Everyone is accountable 

To foster and maintain an inclusive team environment, everyone in the team must be held accountable for supporting inclusive practices. Help your team to understand the connections between organizational goals and inclusive behaviors. Seeing how inclusive organizational procedures and everyday behaviors have a direct impact on how the team makes better decisions and works better together to achieve goals will help the team hold themselves and others accountable to ensure everyone on the team feels included. 

### Model inclusive dialogue 

Open opportunities to hold discussions about inclusion. Through one-on-one sessions or focus groups, employees can express how inclusion looks and feels for them in the organization. Acknowledge resistance to inclusion when present and encourage a respectful and transparent dialogue. 

### Foster a sense of belongingness 

Exercising fair treatment is an essential step to overcome exclusive behaviors and enhance a sense of belongingness among your team. Demonstrate your commitment to treat everyone the same by giving each person an equal chance to be heard and accepted in a consistent manner. 

Follow this [link](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbeshumanresourcescouncil/2019/02/04/what-an-inclusive-workplace-actually-looks-like-and-seven-ways-to-achieve-it/#64934530316b) to read more on how to achieve an inclusive workplace. 

Remember - the practice of inclusion is dynamic, continuous, and operates at different levels. It's a transformational process that will provide them with a positive environment where they can thrive and lead your employees to bring their best selves to work.
